Hit things with mid-air jump slashes.

Jump to the Inn balcony as Zora or Adult Link.
Skip playing Goron Lullaby to enter Snowhead Temple using either Goron Spikes or a HESS.

Hit all 9 keaton bushes with a small sword and small spin attack.

Use Powder Kegs in place of other explosives.
Cross gaps by shielding an explosion during a backflip.
